method: Searches across all twelve Fortinet Community product areas for technical tips, troubleshooting tips, KB/TAC and material release changes. Community material is scenario-only; no community item is used as a primary lesson source.

queries: FortiGate technical-tip troubleshooting-tip October 2026 November 2026
FortiGate FortiOS 7.4.13 proxy inspection 400 Bad Request GUI SSL_ERROR_BAD_MAC_READ VXLAN software switch
findings: Community product page surfaced recent 7.4.13 proxy-inspection 400 Bad Request and GUI SSL_ERROR_BAD_MAC_READ reports, plus VXLAN/software-switch and FortiClient DNS reports; none directly matches transparent conditional DNS forwarding.

queries: FortiManager technical-tip troubleshooting-tip October 2026 November 2026
FortiManager 7.6.7 per-policy lock workspace policy package
findings: No recent directly matched per-policy workspace-lock scenario verified; community search results included other product/release issues, not the selected lock mechanism.

queries: FortiAnalyzer technical-tip troubleshooting-tip October 2026 November 2026
FortiAnalyzer cloud storage connector upload logs S3 Azure Blob Google
findings: Current product-area results included Node2Shell detection, output-profile field masking, log receipt and FortiWeb playbook items; no directly matched storage-connector upload failure was verified.

queries: FortiSwitch technical-tip troubleshooting-tip October 2026 November 2026
FortiSwitchOS dual-signed image signature verification
findings: No recent directly matched dual-signed firmware-image verification scenario verified.

queries: FortiAP wireless technical-tip troubleshooting-tip October 2026 November 2026

findings: No recent directly matched MLO association or multi-link diagnostic scenario verified.

FortiNAC 9.4 SMS Gateway API HTTPS Twilio
findings: Recent FortiNAC PEAP/MSCHAPv2 Windows update scenario was found but was not reused because the 2026-11-07 report already used it; it is unrelated to SMS gateway behavior.

FortiNAC-F FortiGate API key FortiSwitch FortiAP FortiOS 7.6.6
findings: Community article originally posted 2026-09-18 and materially updated 2026-11-04 explains the API token field, why CLI and SNMPv3 remain required, FortiOS token transport changes, and FortiOS 8.0 removal of rest-api-key-url-query.

findings: Search surfaced a 2026-09-17 Web Proxy 'Failed to load resource' issue and a 2026-09-14 approval-revocation session issue; both fall before the rolling 30-day window and neither directly matches agentless tab-sharing mode.

findings: Recent Linux Agent SIGSEGV/systemd scenario was already used in the 2026-11-07 report; no new directly matched AWS Security Hub integration scenario verified.

FortiSASE Inline-CASB SaaS tenant header insertion
findings: A tenant-restriction header-insertion example was found dated 2026-08-03, outside the rolling window; it was not promoted as a recent scenario.

FortiOS 8.0 SD-WAN Setup Wizard license static route
findings: No recent directly matched setup-wizard generation or missing-default-route scenario verified.

summary.policy: No scenario has been invented or substituted from an unrelated product area.
